summary:
MARSWALK 360 is an interactive 3D Martian exploration platform developed to support the planning and understanding of future human exploration missions. Our project focuses on Arcadia Planitia , a region in Mars' northern lowlands with significant geological features and potential near-surface water ice.

Development: We developed a web-based 3D simulation by integrating planetary surface visualizations with scientific research and observations from multiple Mars missions. We selected specific exploration locations (AP-1, AP-8 and AP-9) and incorporated relevant geological, topographical, imaging and subsurface research into the experience.

Addressing the Challenge: The platform provides an interactive environment to examine Martian terrain, investigate scientifically significant locations and understand considerations involved in planning a Marswalk. It translates complex planetary information into an accessible exploration interface.

Importance: Future human missions to Mars will require informed terrain assessment, scientific investigation and effective exploration planning. MARSWALK 360 demonstrates how interactive visualization can make planetary data more accessible while encouraging scientific curiosity and supporting the understanding of future human exploration.
details:
MARSWALK 360

Interactive 3D Exploration of Martian Terrain

What does it do and how does it work?

MARSWALK 360 is a browser-based interactive 3D exploration platform designed to support the understanding and planning of future human exploration on Mars. It focuses on three selected locations in Arcadia Planitia: AP-1, AP-8 and AP-9. Users can explore a simulated Martian environment, examine terrain characteristics and investigate scientifically significant geological features.

Tools and Development

The project was developed using Lovable for website development and AI-assisted tools, including Large Language Models (LLMs), to support the development process. ChatGPT was used for brainstorming, audio-related content, and assistance with creating some visual images. These tools supported the development and creative process of MARSWALK 360, helping shape its website, exploration experience, and presentation of Martian information.

Benefits and Intended Impact

The platform makes complex planetary information more accessible through interactive visualization. Its intended impacts include:

  • Supporting educational engagement with planetary science.
  • Improving accessibility to Martian geographical information.
  • Helping users understand considerations involved in future Marswalk planning.
  • Encouraging research into potential water-ice resources.
  • Promoting interest in planetary exploration and scientific investigation.

Creativity and Innovation

MARSWALK 360 transforms conventional planetary research into an interactive exploration experience. Instead of limiting users to static maps and photographs, it provides an environment where they can virtually investigate selected Martian locations.

Challenge Alignment

The project addresses the challenge of integrating Martian geographical and scientific information into an accessible exploration environment. By focusing on Arcadia Planitia, MARSWALK 360 demonstrates how interactive visualization can help people understand terrain, geological features and considerations relevant to future human exploration.
